author: texsagebrush
body: I do this. I moved but my old OT has such great dungeons that I haven't missed not being able to use WV. So the biggest downsides are you have to go there to build/move buildings and you don't have access to WV. Also if you want other players to come to where you are you'll have to use an alt WV. Probably not worth it until you are very established.

author: Jeronetj3
body: With enough VD you might be able to see your WV to activate it for party play. My WV is also not on top of my house but a little further away (coincidentally near my parents house so whenever I’m over I can adjust my town)

author: Grumbuck
body: I think you need t2, 25 stone and 10 million gold to build a wayvessel. So it wouldn’t take much effort to level an alt and place them in the location you want.
